description:
Snuggle up with 30 cozy winter animals ready to be colored! Each page has one big, bold, simple picture, from a sleepy owl in a striped scarf and a polar bear cub with a snowman to penguins, bunnies, a puppy with a sled and a fox curled up in the snow. Everything is drawn with thick clean lines that are easy for little hands to color.

What's inside
• 30 one-sided coloring pages, with a blank page behind each picture
• Large, simple shapes with plenty of room to color
• Friendly winter animals, snowmen, cozy cabins and snowflakes
• A "This book belongs to" page and a color test page
• Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

Great for crayons, colored pencils and washable markers. A fun quiet-time activity and an easy gift for young children who love animals and snowy days.

The inside pages are printed in black and white, ready for you to color. The colors on the cover are just an example.

The illustrations in this book were generated with AI image tools and were selected and arranged by the publisher, Little Fox Paper Co.

**Price.** 30 pictures is thin for $9.99, so the book is priced in the 50% band. Extending it to 50 pictures (about $0.15 of images, same printing cost) would support $9.99 and a royalty of $3.15: tell Claude if you want that.
